title: Refactor Workflow Modules and Close Common Gaps

story.so_that: the orchestrator/common refactor boundary is clean, the codebase is maintainable, and the workflow engine runs with correctly configured logging and verified behavior
story.i_want: to clean up dead and duplicate orchestrator modules, restore common skill-activity extensibility, move workflow logging configuration into common, and complete common module test coverage

journey.before: Maintains a partially-refactored codebase where orchestrator and common both contain harness, skill-activity, and logging implementations; several common tests do not exercise log paths, stdout/stderr capture, or SkillActivityOutput fields.
journey.during: Uses gaps.md to identify dead duplicates. Decides that file-based Devin harness overrides are not ported; every Activity .config.json must carry its own harness.devin settings. Bakes the prompt output-directory instruction into common/skill_activity.py build_prompt before the modify_prompt hook. Ports setup_worker_logging() to common and has the orchestrator construct and pass an orchestrator-owned WorkflowLoggingConfig at worker setup. Fully removes dead orchestrator files, tests, config, and stale docs, then expands common tests.
journey.after: Orchestrator contains only composition-root code and owns WorkflowLoggingConfig; common owns all generic infrastructure including the worker-logging setup API; no external callers exist so orchestrator copies are safely deleted; unit and end-to-end tests cover the behavior; live full-stack log-tree verification is documented as not available in CI for this component.

capability_breakdown.core_action: Complete the migration of generic workflow infrastructure from orchestrator to common and close the remaining behavior and test-coverage gaps, with orchestrator-owned logging config passed into common APIs

questions.question: Should the file-based Devin harness overrides (defaults and per-skill skills) from orchestrator/devin_harness.config.json be ported into common, or should every Activity .config.json carry the needed harness.devin settings?
questions.answer: Do not port file-based overrides. Every Activity .config.json is responsible for its own harness.devin settings because the activity determines the necessary configuration.

questions.question: How should the prompt output-directory instruction from orchestrator/skill_activity.py be handled in common?
questions.answer: Bake the output-directory instruction into the default prompt format in common/skill_activity.py build_prompt, appending it before the modify_prompt hook is invoked.

questions.question: Is the setup_worker_logging() API still required, and if so, should it be ported to common and called from orchestrator/worker.py?
questions.answer: Yes, port setup_worker_logging() to common. The orchestrator calls it and passes an orchestrator-owned WorkflowLoggingConfig object.

questions.question: Should workflow_logging.config.json be copied or moved from src/orchestrator to src/common?
questions.answer: WorkflowLoggingConfig belongs to the orchestrator. The orchestrator reads workflow_logging.config.json and constructs the config object, then passes it to common's setup_worker_logging. The file stays orchestrator-owned.

questions.question: Are there external callers outside this repository that still import the orchestrator skill_activity, harness, or workflow_logger modules?
questions.answer: No external callers exist, so the orchestrator copies can be fully deleted.

questions.question: How should the live workflow log tree be verified in CI without a long-running Cadence stack?
questions.answer: Live full-stack workflow log tree verification is not available in CI. Rely on unit and end-to-end tests and document that live verification is out of scope for this component.

recommendation: Proceed in small workstreams: 1) remove dead orchestrator files, config, tests, and stale docs; 2) add the output-directory instruction to common/skill_activity.py build_prompt before modify_prompt and restore extensibility hooks/run_skill helper; 3) port setup_worker_logging(config) to common and update orchestrator/worker.py to construct an orchestrator-owned WorkflowLoggingConfig from orchestrator/workflow_logging.config.json and pass it in; 4) expand common tests to cover log contexts, log paths, stdout/stderr capture, SkillActivityOutput fields, and prompt instruction behavior; 5) run the full pytest suite and document that live full-stack log-tree verification is not available in CI for this component.
